archetypes.name: site-count-arithmetic
archetypes.rationale: The plan drives test assertions from very specific enumeration claims (37 post-Step-0, 3 pre-bootstrap, 1 prose = 41 guarded-source lines; 3 residual awk lines) — any miscounting produces silent vacuous coverage or CI failures.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit every enumeration claim in the plan against code evidence in skills/implement/SKILL.md. The plan asserts 37 post-Step-0 source-only sites, 3 pre-bootstrap source+awk sites, and 1 prose fence totalling 41 guarded-source-line instances, plus exactly 3 residual awk-extract lines post-migration; verify these counts by checking the current awk-fence frequency and whether the 40 line-number list (lines 106–1620) is internally consistent with the post-Step-0 vs. pre-bootstrap classification the plan relies on. Check whether the Invariant C test assertions (source count == 41, awk count == 3) are arithmetically consistent with the executable-site breakdown stated elsewhere in the plan, and flag any off-by-one between the description's '~41' figure and the plan's '40 executable + 1 prose'. Confirm the prose example at line 118 is genuinely non-executable so excluding it from the replacement set is safe. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: source-safe-refactor
archetypes.rationale: The plan grafts a BASH_SOURCE guard onto write-session-env.sh to enable safe sourcing — a structural refactor on top of the primary change whose caller-contract implications must be verified against existing callers and the write-session-env.md spec.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine whether the proposed BASH_SOURCE guard ('if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]]; then ... fi') wrapping write-session-env.sh's main body correctly preserves existing caller semantics: confirm that scripts/session-setup.sh and all other current direct-execution callers documented in write-session-env.md continue to hit the guarded main body, and that the plan's new '. "$SCRIPT_DIR/write-session-env.sh"' sourcing from implement-bootstrap.sh loads only emit_plugin_root_env without re-executing argument parsing or the atomic main-output write. Check whether the plan's instructions to update write-session-env.md are sufficient to document the new dual-mode contract (run vs. source, exit-code behaviour, and which outputs fire under each mode). Flag any gap between the plan's description of what the BASH_SOURCE guard prevents and what the current write-session-env.md contract actually guarantees to callers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
